description: Trigger evals for devrites-browser-proof — model-invoked runtime UI proof via the browser-proof ladder (screenshots, viewports, console, network, interactions, design-reference match) recorded to browser-evidence.md.

queries.text: Check the UI in the browser for me.
queries.rationale: Direct trigger phrase from the description.

queries.text: Screenshot this page so we can see it actually renders.
queries.rationale: Screenshot + renders trigger phrase.

queries.text: Prove it renders — don't just tell me it should look fine.
queries.rationale: Prove-it-renders trigger phrase.

queries.text: Open the dashboard in a real browser and capture what it looks like.
queries.rationale: Playwright MCP rung — live browser screenshot of UI.

queries.text: Grab screenshots of this layout at mobile and desktop widths.
queries.rationale: Viewport capture (375/1280) is core browser-proof evidence.

queries.text: Are there any console errors or warnings when this page loads?
queries.rationale: Console observation belongs to the browser-evidence schema.

queries.text: Capture any network failures and console output on the checkout route.
queries.rationale: Route + network + console recording is browser-proof's job.

queries.text: Does the built UI match the design references we saved earlier?
queries.rationale: Design-reference match comparison is explicit browser-proof evidence.

queries.text: Click through the signup flow in the browser and show me each step.
queries.rationale: Interaction-path-tested evidence via the browser ladder.

queries.text: I want runtime evidence the modal opens, not just unit tests.
queries.rationale: Runtime observation of UI behavior is exactly browser-proof over assertions.

queries.text: Take a screenshot of the settings page with Playwright MCP.
queries.rationale: Names the top rung of the ladder directly.

queries.text: Verify the responsive layout looks right on small and large screens.
queries.rationale: Responsive check across viewports is a browser-proof hard rule.

queries.text: Run the full test suite, build, and typecheck to prove the whole feature is done.
queries.rationale: /rite-prove owns whole-feature proof, not just browser observation.

queries.text: Build the settings UI to ship quality with every state covered.
queries.rationale: devrites-frontend-craft owns implementing UI, not proving it.

queries.text: Polish and normalize the dashboard UI before review.
queries.rationale: /rite-polish owns finishing a built UI.

queries.text: The page renders blank and throws in the console — find the root cause.
queries.rationale: diagnose owns debugging a failure, not recording UI proof.

queries.text: Review this diff for correctness bugs and simplifications.
queries.rationale: code-review owns reviewing the diff.

queries.text: Build this feature test-first with a red-green-refactor loop.
queries.rationale: tdd owns test-first implementation.

queries.text: Mock up three different homepage layouts so I can click around.
queries.rationale: prototype owns throwaway UI exploration, not proving the real build.

queries.text: Compact this session into a handoff doc for the next agent.
queries.rationale: handoff owns conversation compaction.
